name: command
behavior: APG combobox pattern with a listbox popup, hosted in an APG dialog (modal) when used as a command palette. The input keeps DOM focus and is role=combobox with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant; the results are role=listbox with role=option rows — options are never focused, only made active. ArrowDown/ArrowUp move the active option (wrapping at the ends), Home/End jump, Enter runs the active option, Esc dismisses the dialog and returns focus to the trigger. Filtering is live and the result count (including 'no results') is announced through a polite live region.

parts.note: the palette panel; inside a dialog it inherits the dialog's scrim and focus trap from the dialog anatomy
search icon + input, ruled off from the list
the combobox; placeholder renders in content-secondary
role=listbox; scrolls, and scrolls the active option into view

parts.statesNote: the ACTIVE option (aria-activedescendant) takes interaction-hover; a chosen/checked option takes interaction-selected — the two are different and must remain distinguishable

parts.note: the keyboard hint; aria-hidden because the shortcut belongs in the option's accessible name only once
the no-results message; lives in the live region

anatomyNotes: Intersection of shadcn Command (cmdk: Command/Input/List/Group/Item/Separator/Empty plus CommandDialog) and Salt ComboBox + ListBox/Option (core combo-box, list-box, option). Salt has no palette component, but its combobox is the same combobox+listbox pair, which is why the intersection holds: the palette is that pair placed in a dialog. Salt's Option renders an optional leading icon and a checkmark on multiselect; the checkmark is the selected recipe on item, not a part. shadcn's CommandShortcut has no Salt counterpart and is therefore optional. Item ACTIVE (roving virtual focus) versus item SELECTED is anatomy-level, not recipe: both must be expressible in every theme.
